name: Pudukkottai

queries.query: Pudukkottai Tamil Nadu official cadastral parcel map GIS land records viewer
queries.result: First-party results identified the Pudukkottai District Survey and Land Records office page, the Tamil Nadu land-records e-Services portal, the Government Services Portal description of Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR access, and TNGIS. The district page states that Pudukkottai and Gandharvakottai taluk FMBs are online on a pilot basis and that Pudukkottai town land records are computerized. No anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.

queries.query: புதுக்கோட்டை நில அளவை வரைபடம் அரசு இணையதளம் பட்டா
queries.result: The official Tamil Pudukkottai district site was found, while the English Survey and Land Records page remains the detailed first-party evidence for computerized FMB and town-land records. Search did not expose a public anonymous parcel-feature endpoint or a downloadable city parcel layer.

registryEvidence.custodian: Government of Tamil Nadu, Department of Survey and Land Records; Pudukkottai District Survey Office
registryEvidence.scope: Local district survey/land-records custodian. The official district page identifies computerized FMBs for Pudukkottai and Gandharvakottai taluks on a pilot basis and computerized town land records for Pudukkottai Municipality.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This evidences a local registry/survey custodian and service route, not open citywide parcel geometry access. The national DILRMP page was recorded as status context only, not as the local custodian.
